# LifePower Control v0.3.0

This release improves job configuration and adds an optional identifying
image for the host system shown on the Overview page.

## Execution-mode-aware job forms

- Saved-job and ad-hoc forms show executable and optional arguments for direct
  execution, or command text for explicit shell execution.
- Inactive mode fields are disabled before submission while the server retains
  the same strict stored-job validation.
- The complete form and validation path remains usable without JavaScript.

## Optional host image

- The authenticated Overview page accepts one JPEG or PNG host image up to
  8 MiB and 16 megapixels.
- The image is displayed in a small square within the Host system panel.
- Uploading a replacement atomically discards the previous image; removal is
  explicit and no image history is retained.
- The private image is preserved with application state during compatible
  upgrades and ordinary uninstall, and is not copied into diagnostics or
  Activity.

## Compatibility and safety

The supported LiFePO4wered/Pi+ hardware, ARM64 Raspberry Pi OS scope, state
schema, installer behavior, hardware safeguards, and power-control boundaries
are unchanged from `v0.2.0`. This release adds no dependency and ordinary tests
remain hardware-independent.
